sections.appearance: She appears to wear an intricately designed sukajan over a French maid outfit. She has a cute little fang. Halo ==== Neru has a black circle with dashed edges merged inside a bigger dashed circle with a yellow triangle in the middle. Uniform ==== She has short vermillion hair with a long crooked cowlick, a back knot and braid tied with two Millennium tags on her left side and wears a French maid headdress. She has sharp red eyes. She wears a black sukajan jacket with red sakura plants, a typical short French maid uniform underneath with loose blue ribbon, and red and black floppy boots. Firearm ==== thumb|Twin Dragon|150px She uses a pair of black SIG Sauer MPX submachine guns with a dandelion pistol grip and stock. A dragon decal is painted on both sides of the receiver. A chain is attached below the collapsing stock connecting both guns.

sections.personality: Neru is harsh, blunt, and bellicose towards others, often expressing annoyance at performing actual cleaning and other typical maid duties. In combat, however, she is easily excited, and boasts that she is unparalleled in close-quarters combat, a claim which she can easily back up. "Collateral Damage" means nothing to her in combat, and she will be as destructive as she wishes in order to accomplish her mission and deal with hostiles. However, she also has a strong Napoleon Complex, and making comments about her height is a fast way to enrage her.
